entries.source: You have got nothing to fear if you are not using filthy arcane magic. Otherwise: DIE!
entries.target: 如果你没有使用肮脏的奥术魔法，那就不用害怕他们。否则的话：去死吧！

entries.source: This crown of pure flames possesses a myriad of small molten rocks floating wildly above it. Each can be removed to throw as a true meteor.
entries.target: 这顶由纯粹火焰所打造的王冠上漂浮着许多小小的熔融石块，每一块都可以取下，当作一颗真正的陨石投掷出去。
被破坏的恶魔空间入侵传送门

entries.source: Do you wish to enter the portal, destroy it, or ignore it (press escape)?
entries.target: 你想要进入传送门，摧毁它，还是无视它（按 Esc 键）？
#GOLD#一件物品从宝箱中掉了出来！

entries.source: As you walk you notice a huge rock falling from the sky. It crashes right near you!
entries.target: 你正匆匆赶路时，你注意到一块巨大的石头正从天而降，在你的身旁坠落！
被破坏的娜迦入侵珊瑚传送门

entries.source: Do you wish to enter the portal, destroy it, or ignore it (press escape)?
entries.target: 你想要进入传送门，摧毁它，还是无视它（按 Esc 键）？

entries.source: You feel a tremor in the ground for a few seconds and it disappears...
entries.target: 你感到脚下的大地震颤了起来，但是几秒钟后这种感觉消失了……

entries.source: #VIOLET# The ramp crumbles as you climb it, followed by the collapse of the cavern.
entries.target: #VIOLET# 当你沿着坡道向上爬时，坡道崩塌了，洞穴随之坍塌。

entries.source: Undead are rising from the ground! You must hold on!
entries.target: 亡灵正从地下升起！你必须坚持住！

entries.source: You have survived the onslaught of undead. You notice a way to climb up you had not seen before in a wall nearby.
entries.target: 你从不死生物的猛攻中存活了下来，你看到旁边的墙上有一条之前没有发现的通路，可以爬上去。

entries.source: Do you wish to disturb the grave?
entries.target: 你想要挖掘这个坟墓吗？

entries.source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

entries.source: As you began digging up the grave, the ground collapsed beneath you. You fall into an eerily lit cavern.
entries.target: 当你开始挖掘坟墓时，脚下的地面塌陷了。你落入一个阴森地亮着光的洞穴。

entries.source: #VIOLET# As you leave the crypt, the stairway collapses in upon itself.
entries.target: #VIOLET# 当你离开地宫的时候，楼梯崩塌了。

entries.source: This ancient skull is all that remains of the Rat Lich. Some fragments of its power remain and a faint red light still glows within its eye sockets.
entries.target: 这枚古老的头骨是鼠巫妖仅存于世的东西，上面残留了鼠巫妖的部分精华能量，眼窝中仍闪烁着微弱的红光。

entries.source: raise one or two undead rats to fight beside you
entries.target: 召唤1-2个亡灵鼠为你作战

entries.source: You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
entries.target: 你不能召唤，你被压制了！

entries.source: %s raises %s %s, and a red light flashes from it's eye sockets!
entries.target: %s 举起了%s%s，一道红光从它的眼窝中闪过！

entries.source: From the dust of decay a %s forms!
entries.target: 一只%s从腐朽的尘埃中成形了！

entries.source: Stairs seem to lead into some kind of crypt.
entries.target: 这道楼梯似乎通向某种地宫。

entries.source: You hear squeaks and the sounds of clicking bone echo around you... Pure death awaits. Flee!
entries.target: 你听到吱吱的叫声和骨头的咔哒声在你周围回荡……纯粹的死亡正等待着你。快逃！
向下通往瓦砾之中的楼梯。
